risks.note: The risk relates to single-source or dominant material suppliers which can cause disruption if they shut down. Mitigated by identifying alternate raw materials or alternate sources of supply for materials feeding critical finished products, including supply from a different geography or an alternative formulation, plus strategic supplier partnerships, inventory buffers and a structured periodic review of supply vulnerabilities, supplier capacity and inventory levels.

Macroeconomic risks leading to inflation in commodity prices, currency fluctuations and geopolitical situations can cause global supply chain disruptions, impacting profitability and operational efficiency. The Company monitors commodity prices, foreign exchange fluctuations and geopolitical developments, and leverages its strong brand equity to pass on cost increases.
risks.risk: Macro-economic factors - commodity inflation, currency and geopolitics

risks.note: Counterfeit and infringement activities carry significant risk of adverse impact on goodwill and brand reputation, consumer trust and confidence, and user safety; separately, leakage or exposure could undermine the confidentiality of the Company's IP. Mitigation spans trademark, design and copyright management, well-known trademark registrations for key brands, hard-to-copy packaging using lens effects and holograms, civil and criminal enforcement against counterfeiters, and physical/digital access controls, data loss prevention and patent filing frameworks at R&D centres and manufacturing facilities.

People safety and health risk at manufacturing locations, offices, R&D centres and warehouses arises from operational hazards such as handling of hazardous material, fire, injury from moving machinery parts, chemical exposure and ergonomic hazards. Mitigated through a 'Zero Harm' goal, ISO 45001:2018 in majority of operations, Behaviour Based Safety programme, lead and lag safety KPI monitoring, engineering and administrative controls, the Happy and Healthy (HAH) Pidilite occupational health programme and periodic health checkups.
risks.risk: Occupational safety and health at workplace, including handling of hazardous chemicals

risks.note: Cyber-attacks, both external and internal, can impact IT infrastructure, with potential collapse of digital infrastructure affecting business applications, network and individual user assets. Mitigated by a cybersecurity framework with advanced technical controls, regular employee training, migration of critical systems and data to secure cloud environments with real-time redundancy, and governance structures overseeing cybersecurity.

Non-compliance with applicable laws and regulations may lead to fines or penalties impacting Company reputation. Mitigated by a comprehensive compliance monitoring system across all entities, an online tool for large entities tracking notified regulatory changes, technology-enabled governance over insider trading and unpublished price sensitive information, periodic training, and periodic audits of compliance practices by the legal and compliance team and external experts.

Risk of non-adherence to laws and regulations relating to plastic waste management. The Company aligns packaging practices with changing regulations, collaborates with multiple waste management agencies, complies 100% to EPR requirements, optimises packaging, reduces virgin plastic usage and uses Post Consumer Recycled (PCR) plastics, with pilots on reuse of rigid plastic packaging.
risks.risk: Plastic waste management and Extended Producer Responsibility
